summary: Noah Holdings filed a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, reporting a series of open-market share repurchases via ADSs on the NYSE from December 2025 through January 2026. The repurchases were executed pursuant to a buyback mandate approved at the June 2025 AGM. Prices ranged from USD 1.975 to USD 2.243 per share, with the largest single tranche being 28,267 ADSs (141,335 ordinary shares) on Dec 23, 2025. All repurchased shares are held for cancellation. The filing is a routine post-execution disclosure, not a tender offer. Watch for future buyback pace as management signals capital return priorities.
